offering_description.value: Operates auctions and online marketplaces for used heavy equipment, commercial trucks and salvage vehicles. It connects insurers, fleet owners, contractors and public agencies with dealers, recyclers and other buyers through online bidding, auction sites and vehicle yards. It also provides logistics, asset valuation and parts procurement tools.

primary_products.value: Used heavy equipment; commercial trucks and trailers; salvage vehicles

primary_services.value: Auctions and marketplace listings; vehicle towing, storage and title processing; equipment transport coordination; asset valuation and market data; parts procurement software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Auto insurers, equipment owners and dealers, fleet operators, vehicle dismantlers and repair businesses; B2G: Government agencies and municipalities disposing of surplus equipment and vehicles; B2C: Individual equipment and vehicle buyers where bidding rules permit

end_markets.value: Auto insurance; construction and heavy equipment; commercial transportation; automotive repair and recycling; agriculture

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Seller commissions on auctioned equipment and vehicles; transaction or usage fees: Buyer fees on auction purchases; service fees: Vehicle towing, storage, title processing and other auction-related services; product sales: Equipment and vehicles purchased for resale under inventory contracts; subscription: Access to equipment valuation data and parts procurement tools
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; transaction or usage fees; service fees; product sales; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Takes in vehicles and equipment from insurers and asset owners for auction to dealers, recyclers and end users; software / platform: Publishes seller listings for bidders and provides market data and procurement tools to equipment businesses; asset operator: Runs auction sites and vehicle yards that receive, store and release assets to buyers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, continental Europe, Australia and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Heavy equipment and truck auctions, salvage vehicle auctions, logistics, asset valuation and parts procurement

distribution_channels.value: online: Online auctions, bidding portals and equipment listing marketplaces; own locations: Company-operated auction sites and vehicle yards for inspection, bidding and pickup; direct sales: Account teams that source consignments from insurers, fleet owners and equipment sellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for motor vehicle auctions and salvage dealers, plus vehicle title and transfer rules
